At Advanced and Preferred Physical Therapy, our conservative approach allows for successful rehabilitation of musculoskeletal conditions. Treatment programs are designed to meet the specific rehabilitation needs of the individual. This will enable the patient to return to maximum performance in work, athletics, and everyday activities.

We created this YouTube account in an effort to provide education and information to the community. If you have any questions or topic requests, please let us know!
